title: Figma Plugin Phase 4 - Missing Generator Coverage
overview: Add Figma generators for the 4 components currently excluded from drift detection: Breadcrumbs, Empty, Field, PageHeader. This completes 100% coverage of components in the registry.

context.problem: 4 components in component-registry.json don't have Figma generators and are excluded in drift-detection.test.ts. This creates gaps in the Figma UI kit.

context.why_now: Phase 3 (parser enhancements + test brittleness fixes) is COMPLETE. Next logical step is achieving 100% component coverage.

primary: Remove components from EXCLUDED_COMPONENTS in drift-detection.test.ts
